mo.description:
OsmAnd is an offline maps and navigation app for people who want reliable guidance, detailed maps, and full control over their routes. Download complete maps by country or region, search by address, place, or coordinates, and navigate with turn-by-turn voice guidance — even without internet access.

With OsmAnd, you can:

· Navigate offline for driving, cycling, walking, hiking, and more
· Plan routes with intermediate stops and automatic rerouting
· Use detailed OpenStreetMap-based maps with POIs, Favorites, and customizable overlays
· Display, record, import, and navigate GPX tracks
· Explore foot, hiking, and bike paths included in offline maps
· Add contour lines and hillshading for better terrain awareness
· Get lane guidance, street names, ETA, and optional screen alerts
· Keep maps on your device for dependable use at home, abroad, and in remote areas

OsmAnd is built for everyday navigation, travel, and outdoor exploration. It combines offline reliability with powerful route planning, detailed map data, and advanced tools for users who want more than a basic navigation app.

Built on OpenStreetMap and developed as an open-source project, OsmAnd is privacy-friendly and gives you control over your data and app access. Maps are available worldwide and updated regularly, with optional hourly updates through Live Updates feature.

Terms of Use: https://osmand.net/docs/legal/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://osmand.net/docs/legal/privacy-policy
mo.releaseNotes:
• Redesigned "My Places" — with Favorites subfolders, pinned folders, and quicker actions
• Rebuilt "Plan a Route" — add route and POI points, and combine different route types
• New Astronomy plugin: star map with a detailed database for each object, visibility graphs, and an observation schedule
• Added "Terrain shadows" visualization type
• Added support for Road-only maps
• Edit the color palette for Tracks and Terrain
• Auto-organize tracks by year, length, activity, and more
• Split multi-track GPX files into separate files on import
• Set a default appearance for Track folders
• Added a bicycle width setting to avoid narrow cycleways
• Added an OBD-II adapter voltage widget
• Added a "Pause spoken audio" option to pause podcasts or audiobooks during navigation instructions
• Full icon selection now available for profiles
• Improved performance when managing a large number of Favorites
• Fixed an issue with the CarPlay trial period

tw.description:
Grok 是由 xAI 開發的強大人工智慧助手。它被設計為最大限度地真實、有用且富有好奇心，幫助你獲得更好的答案、更快地創作，並即時理解這個世界。無論你需要智慧對話、深度研究、程式協助，還是高品質的圖像與影片生成，Grok 都能做到。

人工智慧助手
隨便問，即可獲得快速、條理清晰的回覆。讓 Grok 在網路上進行深度研究，解決數學、科學和程式中的複雜問題，或在對話中分析文件、照片和連結。這款人工智慧助手能把複雜主題轉化為清晰、可執行的洞察，並以強大的推理能力處理多步驟任務。

Grok Imagine – AI 圖像與影片生成
體驗快速而強大的 AI 圖像和影片創作。根據文字生成令人驚豔的圖像，建立帶聲音的短影片，或把照片變成動態影片。你甚至可以只用聲音生成圖像。還可以編輯既有圖片：移除物件、更換背景，或套用藝術風格——全程精準可控、畫質出色。

Grok 語音模式
與 Grok 進行自然的語音對話。對著你的人工智慧助手說話，即可即時獲得接近真人的回覆。你還可以個人化互動方式，並選擇適合自己的對話風格。

來自 X 的即時資訊
獲得最新答案。憑藉對 X 和網路的直接存取，這款人工智慧助手能讓你隨時掌握最新新聞、趨勢和正在發生的討論。讓 Grok 在 X 上進行進階搜尋，看看人們真正在說什麼。

輕鬆將內容脈絡轉移到 Grok
已經在使用 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 或其他 AI 工具？可以把對話和內容脈絡輕鬆轉移到 Grok，繼續工作，不必從頭開始。

真實使用情境
學生用 Grok 學習並獲得清晰講解。職場人士用它做研究、寫作、分析並解決問題。內容創作者可在數秒內生成客製圖像和影片。開發者能獲得強而有力的程式協助與技術洞察。任何想要快速、真實、富有創造力的人工智慧助手的人，都能從 Grok 中受益。

Grok 適合誰？
Grok 為那些不滿足於基礎答案的好奇之人而打造。它非常適合學生、職場人士、創作者、研究者，以及所有希望同時擁有強大 AI 對話體驗與先進圖像、影片和智慧體能力的人。如果你看重求真、創造力和即時知識，Grok 就是為你準備的。

有了 Grok 作為你的個人人工智慧助手，探索知識、激發創意、完成實際工作都會更快、更有趣。立即下載 Grok，體驗真正有幫助的人工智慧。

隱私權政策：https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy

tr.releaseNotes:
New

- AI: Added Raycast AI Credits and the new Max plan, with clear monthly allowances for Pro, Pro+, and Max

Improvements

- AI: Added credit balances, usage details, and relative cost indicators in the model picker
- AI: Using your own AI provider API keys now requires a Raycast Pro plan.
- AI: Models are now grouped more consistently by provider, including models from Vercel AI Gateway
- AI: Improved chat reliability when tools fail and while preparing longer conversations
- Snippets: Expansions now work after symbols and immediately after another expansion
- Home: Tap the selected tab again to quickly scroll back to the top
- Dictation: Improved reliability when the active audio device changes

Fixes

- AI: Failed attachments now show clear recovery actions and can be removed
- AI: Fixed crashes and layout issues affecting source links
- AI: Fixed Quick AI model selection not refreshing after changes
- AI: Fixed an issue where prompts from desktop automation runs appeared blank on iOS
- Notes: Fixed Markdown appearing in titles of notes created by AI
- Subscriptions: Fixed the previous account’s plan briefly appearing after signing in with a different account.
tr.description:
Introducing Raycast for iOS: Your all-in-one productivity toolkit with AI, notes, and more – now on mobile as the perfect companion to the macOS app.

The app brings your favorite productivity tools from the Mac into your pocket. With Raycast for iOS, you can:
• Chat with dozens of AI models from leading providers to get the perfect answers for any task
• Capture, organize, and access your thoughts to never lose an important idea again
• Save and open Quicklinks for instant access to your most important resources
• Store and reuse code snippets and templates to save time on repetitive workflows
• Enjoy seamless cloud sync to keep all your content updated across devices

Whether you're a long-time Mac user or just discovering Raycast on iOS, you'll have your essential productivity tools always at hand. Raycast for iOS seamlessly extends your desktop workflow to mobile, ensuring you stay productive and organized wherever life takes you.

Please note: Raycast for iOS requires a free Raycast account. Premium features available with a Raycast Pro subscription.

Terms of Service: https://www.raycast.com/terms-of-service
